question.text:
Consider the statement p : If a cylinder is right circular cylinder then its volume is 13πr2h.
Contrapositive of the statement p is

options.text: If the volume of a cylinder is <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac><mi>π</mi><msup><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi>h</mi></math> then it is not right circular cylinder

If the volume of a cylinder is not <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac><mi>π</mi><msup><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi>h</mi></math> then it is not right circular cylinder

If a cylinder is not right circular cylinder then its volume is not <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac><mi>π</mi><msup><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi>h</mi></math>

solution.text:
Contrapositive of “p→q” is “~q→~p”

Hence, the contrapositive of the given statement is: If the volume of a cylinder is not 13πr2h then it is not right circular cylinder
